**What is the best therapy for weight loss?**

Mental blocks around weight often stem from emotional eating, past struggles, or anxiety about change. Our therapists work with clients to build coping skills, set realistic goals and practice mindful eating. We address the emotional side of food in both group and individual sessions. Progress takes time, but you do not have to work through it alone.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is Overeaters Anonymous worth it?**

OA meetings offer peer support and community, which many people find valuable. At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we complement that approach with professional clinical care: licensed therapists, registered dietitians, cooking classes and movement education in one program. We work with people who attend OA, people who have tried it, and people exploring other paths.

**What is overeating a symptom of?**

Overeating can be tied to stress, anxiety, depression, binge eating disorder, or learned patterns around food. A licensed therapist or psychologist is the right person to explore what is driving it in your specific situation. We help clients understand and modify their relationship with food through behavioral therapy, dietary guidance and coping skills.

**What is the easiest way to stop overeating?**

There is no single easy fix, but understanding the emotional and behavioral patterns behind overeating is a strong foundation. We teach coping skills, mindful eating, nutritional planning and goal setting in group and individual therapy. Recovery takes time, and we provide structured support over roughly three months and 30 sessions in our Intensive Outpatient Program.

**What are the controversies surrounding Overeaters Anonymous?**

Some people appreciate OA's spiritual foundation and 12-step structure. Others prefer a clinical, evidence-based approach with licensed professionals. At BCC, we respect all pathways and do not replace OA. We offer comprehensive behavioral healthcare that can stand alone or work alongside peer support groups, depending on what fits your needs.

If you are looking for professional support for overeating, we are here to help. Reach out to learn more about our program.

Hi Mayra,

Thank you for being on our referral newsletter list. I noticed your Mental Health Links page has an Eating Disorders section with national resources, and your Disordered Eating page describes the binging and the shame around food that many of our clients also carry.

We run an intensive outpatient program in San Antonio for binge eating, chronic over-eating and food addiction: group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education, in one program. It is in network with most health insurance plans, and clients attend onsite or by Zoom.

Would you add us to the Eating Disorders section at https://vitalitylifecounselingsa.com/mental-health-links? Our homepage is https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/ and the link text could be "Bariatric Counseling Center of San Antonio (binge eating and overeating program)".

In return we will list Vitality Life Counseling as a referral partner on our website, and we are glad to refer clients who need individual therapy outside our program.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio

captions.FB:
A craving isn't a failure. It's information.

When you feel a strong urge to eat, your body or mind is trying to tell you something. Maybe you're truly hungry. Maybe you're stressed, tired, or lonely. Maybe a certain food is tied to a memory or a feeling of comfort.

At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we teach clients to pause and ask: What is this craving really about?

That question is at the heart of Mindful Eating and Coping Skills, part of our Behavioral Therapy & Counseling pillar. We help people understand and modify their relationship with food, not through rules or restriction, but through awareness and compassion.

Our program includes group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education. One program, not four.

Serving clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the best therapy for weight loss?**

The best therapy addresses the behaviors and emotions behind overeating. At the Bariatric Counseling Center, we combine group and individual therapy, dietary guidance from registered dietitians, cooking classes and movement education in one comprehensive program. We help clients understand and modify their relationship with food. A licensed therapist can help you determine which approach fits your needs.

**How do I get over the mental block of weight loss?**

Mental blocks around weight often stem from emotional eating, past struggles, or anxiety about change. Our therapists work with clients to build coping skills, set realistic goals and practice mindful eating. We address the emotional side of food in both group and individual sessions. Progress takes time, but you do not have to work through it alone.

**How do I talk to someone about losing weight?**

If you are the one struggling, reaching out to a licensed therapist or counselor is a strong first step. Our team listens without judgment and helps you explore what is driving your relationship with food. If you are supporting someone else, focus on care and concern, not criticism. Let them lead the conversation and offer to help them find resources.

If you are ready to explore how counseling can support your goals, reach out to us. We are here to help.

meta: META_ACCESS_TOKEN not set. To connect Facebook and Instagram:
1. developers.facebook.com: create an app (type Business), add the Facebook Login and Instagram Graph products.
2. Graph API Explorer: pick the app, choose the BCC Page as the token owner, grant pages_read_engagement, pages_read_user_content, read_insights, instagram_basic, instagram_manage_insights, ads_read.

3. Exchange it for a long-lived Page token (Access Token Debugger, Extend), then paste it in seo-tools/.env as META_ACCESS_TOKEN=... and put the Page id and Instagram Business id in social.json under own.
4. Meta Ad Library also needs one-time identity confirmation at facebook.com/ID before the ads_archive endpoint answers.
youtube: YOUTUBE_API_KEY not set. To connect YouTube (own channel and competitors):
1. console.cloud.google.com: any project, APIs and Services, Enable APIs, turn on YouTube Data API v3.
2. Credentials, Create credentials, API key. Restrict it to the YouTube Data API v3 only.
3. Paste it in seo-tools/.env as YOUTUBE_API_KEY=... and put the BCC channel id (UC...) or @handle in social.json under own.youtube_channel_id.
linkedin: LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN not set. LinkedIn is the hardest one and is optional:
1. linkedin.com/developers: create an app tied to the BCC Company Page, request the Community Management API (approval takes days).
2. OAuth with r_organization_social and rw_organization_admin as a Page admin; tokens last 60 days.
3. Paste it in .env as LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN=... and the numeric organization id in social.json under own.linkedin_org_id.
